text:
Maya: Quick heads up — thinking about how we do the v2 nudge. Idea: show a "consent bump" in Console that requires an explicit opt-in for migration, instead of silently switching tenants to v2. This would be shown to tenants hitting the route for the first time after the grace window. Anyone worried about telemetry/metrics or quota side-effects?

Chris: +1 for explicit opt-in. How do we measure adoption? need a metric slice for 'consent_shown', 'consent_accepted', 'consent_declined'. Also worry about accidental spikes when the banner hits many users at once.

Lee: If we force opt-in, routing implications: we can't autoswitch traffic to v2 for dedicated/dedicated-noncompatible variants. Need a fallback rule to keep v1 serving for tenants who decline. Also quota recalculation for route-level quotas — opt-ins might change capacity planning.

Andrew: Could we add a 'soft_opt_in' where clicking accept only enrolls in a shadow mode for 7 days (shadow + trace) and then a confirm prompt? That reduces churn and gives telemetry.

Maya: Love the shadow idea. Proposed rollout: 1) show consent bump 2) if accept -> shadow for 7d with telemetry + warning toast 3) after 7d show 'confirm migrate' CTA OR auto-migrate if metrics stable. For declines, show a "remind me later" with exponential backoff. Thoughts on UX phrasing?

Chris: Need dashboard hooks. Console should expose counts by tenant: shown/accepted/confirmed/declined + rate-limited alerts if large drop in acceptance. Also useful to expose 'traffic shift' forecast per region.

Lee: From routing side we'll implement rule: tenant_has_consented -> route to v2 variants, else route to v1. Need a tenant flag in token metadata. Also consider header fallback for client libraries that don't propagate consent yet.

Maya: Implementation detail: console writes tenant metadata via control-plane API: POST /tenants/{id}/consent {mode: 'shadow'|'confirmed'|'declined'}. We'll need a small schema and audit log. Andrew can you mock the API?

Andrew: Yep. Quick sketch:
```json
POST /tenants/123/consent
{ "mode": "shadow", "source": "console", "timestamp": 1732104321 }
```

Maya: Also need telemetry tags: consent.source, consent.mode, consent.result + route.hash before and after. We'll tie to rollout dashboards.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: consent-bump feature flag to canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC — ticket #INFR-2123

Chris: One more: quota accounting. If a tenant shadows to v2, do we meter on v2 tokens or keep billing on v1 until confirm? Prefer billing stability — keep billing on v1 until confirm to avoid unexpected billing changes.

Lee: Agree. Routing will mirror that: traffic may flow to v2 runtime but we keep quota counters pegged to original route id until confirmed. That requires a binding in the request metadata.

Maya: ok action items: Andrew - API mock + sample payloads; Chris - dashboard panels and alert thresholds; Lee - routing flag & quota-binding spec; I'll draft consent copy for UX. I'll post a short RFC tomorrow. Thanks!

Andrew: On it :+1:

Chris: noted :eyes:

Lee: sounds good to me :thumbsup:
